name: Museo del Espacio Matemático
description: 30+ interactive math & physics simulations (hydrogen orbitals, dipole radiation, Fourier epicycles) in WebGL and Web Audio, several controlled by on-device webcam hand tracking.

name: Market Price Analytics (deferia.cr)
description: Interactive dashboard over 9,184 weekly CNP agricultural price records (56 products, 2021–2024) from the UCR × FAO deferia.cr project: trends, seasonality and product comparisons.

name: ECCI QR Access Control
description: Working demo of a QR-based computer sign-in workflow designed, from interviews with faculty, security staff and students, to replace manual device registration.

name: Geopolitical Risk Analytics
description: Interactive dashboard that explores geopolitical risk indicators and their relationship with economic instability across countries.

name: Mejengas App
description: Real-time Flutter application for live session management, letting players join via unique codes with real-time synchronization and automatic team balancing.
